verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only n8n's inbound Webhook trigger node ([n8n-docs-21], a page title only) and community mention of 'webhook-initiated tasks' ([n8n-comm-18]). Both describe receiving HTTP calls to start workflows. Nothing documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer could subscribe to for n8n events, so the inbound trigger is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
